senses.gloss: f. ch. = h.<cite ref="N00505"><he>נֶחָמָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="N00512"><he>נֶחֱמָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00509"><he>נַחֲמַן</he></cite>.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 1:21">Targ. Y. Gen. I, 21</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 18:4">Targ. Is. XVIII, 4</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>נִיחֲמַן</he>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 38a:15">B. Kam. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>מאי אית לי גבי נ׳ דבבלאי</he> what do I care for the consolations of the Babylonians? <cite ref="Bava Batra 14b:10">B. Bath. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>וסיפיה נ׳</he> and ends with consolations.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 14b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>סמכינן … ונ׳ לנ׳</he> we join … the consolations at the end of one book to those at the beginning of the next, v. <cite ref="H00458"><he>חוּרְבָּנָא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:5">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>וכל טבן ונ׳ וכ׳</he> and all the good times and consolations (predicted) in the world have come true in my own days.
